issues.description: The exercise text names the same method with two different identifiers: the problem statement's task text refers to get_total_number_of_students() (snake_case), whereas the UML diagram, the template comments, and the reference implementation use getTotalNumberOfStudents() (camelCase). This mismatch concerns the exact Java method name students are expected to implement. Because Java and the provided tests/UML use camelCase, the snake_case reference in the instructions can mislead students into implementing the wrong method name and cause failing tests or compilation issues.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the problem statement to use the camelCase Java method name getTotalNumberOfStudents() everywhere (replace get_total_number_of_students()). Ensure the task description, examples, and any hints match the UML, template comments, and tests so students implement the correct Java method name.
